headline: Aon Appoints Darren Van't Hof as Head of Transaction Solutions Tax Credit Financing
summary: CHICAGO, August 04, 2026--Aon plc (NYSE: AON) today announced the appointment of Darren Van’t Hof to serve as Head of Tax Credit Financing, Transaction Solutions, effective August 17, 2026.
